cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Test the Story First
cards.instruction: Get someone else to repeat the explanation, ask the dangerous question, or test the risky step before you commit.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Try this banking-delay explanation for the missing raffle money on the chair before I sign it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm not defending your accounts again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Just test the explanation. If she accepts it, I'll sign and handle every question.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She'll recognise your handwriting before I speak.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leave the paper. Ask whether a banking delay sounds plausible. If she asks whose money, come back before answering.
